title: HRS-Bench: Holistic, Reliable and Scalable Benchmark for Text-to-Image Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on accuracy, robustness, generalization, fairness (gender, style), and bias (gender, race, age) in text-to-image models.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
